text: Inspection corrects the initial diagnosis: NativeArtifacts already calls ResultManifest.packed and writes binary density payloads under schema v2. Excess heap comes from temporary full inline-cell JSON in DensityArchiveCodec.encode/materialize, NativeArtifactPackage existential-result reencoding, boxed byte vectors, and repeated whole-document parses per payload relation. Preserve existing schema and canonical bytes; remove these allocation detours without a wire migration. Slices archive-density-memory and archive-native-memory carry implementation and qualification.
